name: Story rail
summary: A row of story rings with people's photos that scrolls sideways inside its box: your own add ring first, unseen stories in an accent ring, close friends marked with a star, a live badge, and seen ones in grey.
use: at the top of a social or media feed, for the stories people have posted today
a11y: Each story is a button whose name says who posted it and whether it is new, live or seen; opening one marks it seen, and on wider screens two arrow buttons scroll the rail.

use_when: a row of people or channels with something new, where opening one clears its ring
avoid_when: suggesting people to follow: use follow-suggestions
a row of shows, albums or products: use media-shelf
a full list of members with roles: use member-list

parts.name: new_count
parts.what: how many stories are unseen, or All seen

parts.name: arrows
parts.what: scroll back and forward; hidden on phones

parts.name: stories
parts.what: one story ring with a photo and a name; the first is your own add ring

parts.name: photo
parts.what: the poster's photo inside its ring

parts.name: badge
parts.what: a plus on your own ring or a star for close friends

parts.name: live
parts.what: a LIVE tag under the ring

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if stories fail to load, keep your own ring and put a short retry line beside it

disabled.how: the back arrow is disabled at the start and the forward arrow at the end of the rail

overflow.how: the rail scrolls sideways in its own box with snap points, fading at the end until you reach it

long_text.how: a name wider than its ring is cut off with an ellipsis

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab moves through the back and forward arrows, then each story in order
Enter or Space on an arrow scrolls the rail by most of its width
Enter or Space on a story opens it and marks it seen; on your own ring it is the add action
